sources.title: Recording Proof of Delivery
sources.scope: Primary body fetched on the accessed date during approved research; JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Transportation Management 9.2 delivery evidence fields.
supported_claims: The documented POD form records delivery date, delivery time, and received-by information.
sources.limitations: Does not establish this scenario's revision, quantity, time-order, tariff, or evidence-completeness rules. No live delivery confirmation is performed.

sources.title: Understanding Invoice Matching
sources.scope: Primary body fetched on the accessed date during approved research; documented freight invoice matching context.
supported_claims: Freight invoice matching compares invoiced amounts with calculated shipment charges.
The documented downstream accounts-payable voucher is outside this synthetic review.
sources.limitations: Does not supply universal tolerances, rates, a reconciliation algorithm, payment permission, or an Oracle-compatible export schema.

sources.title: Matching Freight Invoices
sources.scope: Primary body fetched on the accessed date during approved research; invoice header and selected freight-charge association.
supported_claims: Invoice header information includes supplier, invoice number, and dates.
Selected freight charges are associated with the invoice for review.
sources.limitations: Neutral synthetic fields are not an Oracle import/API schema; no voucher, carrier contact, AP action, or financial posting is implemented.
